decision: REJECT current native structure; revision requested
findings: New generated concept preserves readable seated pose, but authored native grid loses it.
Face collapses into a narrow warm vertical block without a readable eye/cheek distinction.
Cape and trouser columns dominate; hips and knee folds have inadequate horizontal projection.
Stool seat is not independently legible enough to anchor the seated pose.
Limited palette and transparent center gap alone do not establish pose or style quality.
requested_revision: Enlarge head visual mass; restore face clusters, seated hip/knee projection and visible stool seat while keeping two covered legs and separate hands. Preserve original concept.
